_comment: Optional Claude Code convenience layer — deleting the whole .claude/ directory leaves a fully functional project. Enforcement lives in pre-commit and CI; this hook only surfaces failures earlier, in-session, and the deny rules mirror the AGENTS.md branch discipline (no pushes to main, no force pushes, no history rewrites, no --no-verify gate-skipping) for Claude Code sessions. CI is the authoritative gate regardless; these denies just stop a session skipping it. The allow list is a scoped allowlist for /orchestrate (headless workers + git worktree management) plus this project's own test/run loop; it does NOT switch the project into a full bypass mode.
_comment_hook: The PostToolUse hook is FORMAT ONLY, in both languages. It used to run the full pytest suite after every single edit, which is wrong twice over: on any real suite it is far too slow for a per-edit hook, and it fires mid-refactor when tests are legitimately red — so its exit 2 blocks the session precisely while you are in the middle of the multi-step change that would make it pass again. Tests belong at the commit boundary, where pre-commit runs them, and in CI, which is authoritative. Formatting is the only thing cheap enough and safe enough to do on every write.
_comment_session_start: SessionStart runs this project's own setup script, which makes a fresh sandbox able to run the suite (pip installs, NLTK data). It is PreLexy's, not the template's, and is kept across template updates.

hooks.command: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv run ruff format --quiet . || true
